gaps.title: Gaze is built but never wired
gaps.detail: ch.lookAt(worldVec3) exists in src/art/anim.js and is exposed on every character, but nothing calls it: characters always stare straight ahead instead of looking at the player, the speaker, or what they are doing. Wire it in npc.js, dialogue and field, and add idle glances.

events.note: npc.js already calls m.lookAt toward hero when close/talking; idleLook for work/partners
